title: Working AI Into Your Office Space: How VergeSense Enables Data‑Driven Workplaces
summary: How VergeSense supports AI‑enabled office transformations: using data‑driven occupancy insights to optimize space and enhance workplace strategy.
body_markdown:
By: Smart Buildings Magazine


This article explores how AI is being integrated into office environments to enhance workplace strategy—a trend strongly echoed by VergeSense’s leadership. CTO Kelby Green emphasizes the value of AI‑driven occupancy insights in helping workplace teams adapt swiftly amid evolving work patterns. Companies adopting this approach can understand actual usage, optimize space, and foster employee satisfaction through intelligent, actionable data.
